scope: Two general graph-level statements: if deleting a selected vertex covers the newly omitted vertex and every old omitted vertex except one port, minimality forces that port to be omitted and its only selected neighbor to be its retained external support; therefore all internal neighbors are omitted. Two conditional list/count theorems sum additive per-port losses without reusing a block deficit and yield the periodic-phase upper bound. The Fano local loss proof, periodic certificate table and graph-to-count instantiation retain written proofs; the full Heawood inequality and all-k SF conjecture are not formalized or settled here.
